title: Steal Drugs from RM

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Hey, Takeout! Poisoned anyone lately?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, Takeout! Poisoned anyone lately?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Ha ha. Remind me not to piss you off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha ha. Remind me not to piss you off.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Sorry friend. It’s been a day. Do you know how many call-outs we had already? Eighteen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry friend. It’s been a day. Do you know how many call-outs we had already? Eighteen.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Glad to hear it because it has been a DAY. You know how many call-outs we had already? Eighteen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glad to hear it because it has been a DAY. You know how many call-outs we had already? Eighteen.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Four toxic slime virus infections, three dismemberments, one guy who tried to surf a steam vent on his HOVA board… Oh wait, you were just being polite.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Four toxic slime virus infections, three dismemberments, one guy who tried to surf a steam vent on his HOVA board… Oh wait, you were just being polite.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: That stuff is the good shit. When a patient has a MedSynge sub, I don't have to lie when I tell them everything's gonna be alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That stuff is the good shit. When a patient has a MedSynge sub, I don't have to lie when I tell them everything's gonna be alright.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: We carry it. Been mugged for it three times this month already. It’s got a street value higher than vintage Joos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We carry it. Been mugged for it three times this month already. It’s got a street value higher than vintage Joos.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Takeout, don’t even go there. MedSynge makes us register every single dose. When a batch goes missing, we have to pay for it personally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Takeout, don’t even go there. MedSynge makes us register every single dose. When a batch goes missing, we have to pay for it personally.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Sure, people sell it. Watered down and cut with CORA-knows what. Why you asking?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, people sell it. Watered down and cut with CORA-knows what. Why you asking?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Who runs a free clinic by any chance? I told you, don't go there. If I helped every charity quack I wouldn't have a job. It’s about doing what you can, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who runs a free clinic by any chance? I told you, don't go there. If I helped every charity quack I wouldn't have a job. It’s about doing what you can, right?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Hey, I don't blame you for trying. See ya, Takeout.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I don't blame you for trying. See ya, Takeout.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: And you sound like you lost half your brain in the Sewers. Wise up, Takeout.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you sound like you lost half your brain in the Sewers. Wise up, Takeout.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Sure does. Why you asking?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure does. Why you asking?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: "No reason". Whatever. I gotta go. See ya around, Takeout.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "No reason". Whatever. I gotta go. See ya around, Takeout.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: What I need is a pack of stims. And I’m all out. You got any?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What I need is a pack of stims. And I’m all out. You got any?

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Uhh, I don’t have the strength to haul this thing over to the market and back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uhh, I don’t have the strength to haul this thing over to the market and back.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: There’s some expensive shit in there, Takeout. If I'm gonna trust you...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There’s some expensive shit in there, Takeout. If I'm gonna trust you...

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: You look like you could use a stim too. OK, I won’t be long. Thanks, Takeout.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You look like you could use a stim too. OK, I won’t be long. Thanks, Takeout.

nodes.speaker: R M Alken
nodes.text: Sorry, Takeout. Can't take the risk. Nothing personal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, Takeout. Can't take the risk. Nothing personal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No one I cared about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No one I cared about.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oof. Low blow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oof. Low blow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's ok, you're on my "Do Not Poison" list.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's ok, you're on my "Do Not Poison" list.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's ok, you're on my "Do Not Poison" list.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's ok, you're on my "Do Not Poison" list.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever heard of BioX-50?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever heard of BioX-50?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you ever heard of BioX-50?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you ever heard of BioX-50?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you carry it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you carry it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So if I wanted to buy some…?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So if I wanted to buy some…?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So if I wanted to buy some…?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So if I wanted to buy some…?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So no one sells it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So no one sells it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sucks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sucks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need some for a doctor friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need some for a doctor friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need some for a doctor friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need some for a doctor friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sound like a Corpster.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sound like a Corpster.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No reason.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No reason.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you need a break.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you need a break.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like you need a break.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like you need a break.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not on me, sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not on me, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope. You ever heard of BioX-50?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope. You ever heard of BioX-50?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nope. You ever heard of BioX-50?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nope. You ever heard of BioX-50?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can watch it while you go buy some.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can watch it while you go buy some.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can watch it while you go buy some.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can watch it while you go buy some.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I look like a bootlegger?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I look like a bootlegger?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do I look like a bootlegger?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do I look like a bootlegger?
